panels.title: Запас прочности целиков панели П-1 (SF; 1,3 и 1,5)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.thingId =~ /^org\.openegiz\.zhezkazgan:c1-/ and r._field == "value_sf_properties_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, twin: r.thingId}))
  |> group(columns: ["twin"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

import "types"
from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.thingId =~ /^org\.openegiz\.zhezkazgan:c[1-3]-/ and (r._field == "value_height_properties_value" or r._field == "value_strength_properties_value" or r._field == "value_stress_properties_value" or r._field == "value_sf_properties_value" or r._field == "value_convergence_properties_value"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => types.isNumeric(v: r._value))
  |> group(columns: ["thingId", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["thingId"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_measurement", "parent", "originator", "correlationId", "topic", "host"])

import "types"
from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.thingId =~ /^org\.openegiz\.zhezkazgan:c[1-3]-/ and (r._field == "value_status_properties_value" or r._field == "value_extracted_properties_value"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (types.isType(v: r._value, type: "string") or types.isType(v: r._value, type: "bool")))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: string(v: r._value)}))
  |> group(columns: ["thingId", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["thingId"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_measurement", "parent", "originator", "correlationId", "topic", "host"])
